title: Community garden plot permit
description: Fictional municipal service for residents applying to use a small public garden plot.
full_text: Applicants must live in the fictional municipality of Nordhafen and submit the form with proof of residence. The fictional processing fee is 12 euros. Applications are normally processed within ten working days.

sections.requirements: The applicant must be at least 18 years old and have a registered residence in the fictional municipality of Nordhafen.
sections.required_documents: Completed application form and a fictional proof-of-residence document issued within the last three months.
sections.fees: The fictional processing fee is 12 euros. This amount is for demonstration only.
sections.processing_time: Applications are normally processed within ten working days in this fictional example.
sections.responsibility_notes: The fictional Community Spaces Office handles the application.
sections.forms: Use the fictional form CG-01 included in the imaginary municipal form catalogue.
sections.online_abwicklung: The fictional application can be started online, but the signed form must then be uploaded.
sections.additional_information: This service and all details are fictional.

title: Mobile library card application
description: Fictional application for a mobile library card in Nordhafen.
full_text: Residents aged 16 or older may apply with identification and a fictional proof of address. The fictional annual fee is 5 euros and processing usually takes two working days.

sections.requirements: Applicants must be at least 16 years old and live in the fictional municipality of Nordhafen.
sections.required_documents: A fictional identity document and proof of address are required. Applicants under 18 also provide a fictional guardian consent form.
sections.fees: The fictional annual fee is 5 euros. This amount is for demonstration only.
sections.processing_time: The fictional card is usually activated within two working days.
sections.responsibility_notes: The fictional Nordhafen Mobile Library team handles applications.
sections.online_abwicklung: The fictional application may be submitted online.
sections.additional_information: This service and all details are fictional.

title: Neighbourhood market stall registration
description: Fictional registration for a temporary stall at a neighbourhood market.
full_text: The fictional market accepts registrations from adults with a product description and safety declaration. The fictional fee is 20 euros per market day. Processing normally takes five working days.

sections.requirements: The fictional stall operator must be at least 18 years old and describe the goods offered.
sections.required_documents: Completed fictional form MS-03, product description, and signed fictional safety declaration.
sections.fees: The fictional fee is 20 euros for each market day. This amount is for demonstration only.
sections.processing_time: Registration is normally processed within five working days in this fictional example.
sections.responsibility_notes: The fictional Local Markets Desk handles registration.
sections.online_abwicklung: The fictional registration can be submitted online with all documents attached.
sections.additional_information: This service and all details are fictional.

title: Residential bicycle-box access request
description: Fictional request for access to a secure public bicycle box.
full_text: Adults living in the fictional pilot area may request access using proof of residence and a bicycle description. There is no fictional application fee. A decision is normally issued within seven working days.

sections.requirements: Applicants must be at least 18 years old and live inside the fictional Nordhafen bicycle-box pilot area.
sections.required_documents: Fictional proof of residence and a short description of the bicycle are required.
sections.fees: There is no application fee in this fictional example.
sections.processing_time: A fictional decision is normally issued within seven working days.
sections.responsibility_notes: The fictional Sustainable Mobility Office handles requests.
sections.online_abwicklung: The fictional request can be completed online.
sections.additional_information: This service and all details are fictional.

title: Community event-room booking request
description: Fictional request to reserve a municipal room for a non-commercial neighbourhood event.
full_text: A fictional booking request requires an event description, preferred date, and responsible contact person. The fictional room fee is 30 euros. Availability is confirmed within three working days.

sections.requirements: The fictional event must be non-commercial, end by 22:00, and name one adult responsible contact person.
sections.required_documents: Fictional booking form ER-05 and a short event description are required.
sections.fees: The fictional room fee is 30 euros per event. This amount is for demonstration only.
sections.processing_time: Availability is normally confirmed within three working days in this fictional example.
sections.responsibility_notes: The fictional Neighbourhood Facilities Team handles requests.
sections.online_abwicklung: The fictional booking request can be submitted online.
sections.additional_information: This service and all details are fictional.
